# Adrian Mejia Blog

> A comprehensive resource for mastering data structures, algorithms, and JavaScript development with practical tutorials and interview preparation guides.

Adrian Mejia's blog focuses on computer science fundamentals, algorithm analysis, and full-stack JavaScript development. The site includes detailed tutorials on data structures, complexity analysis, graph algorithms, and the MEAN stack, alongside a published DSA.js book for deeper learning.

## Key Topics

- Data Structures
- Algorithms
- Time Complexity
- Big O Notation
- JavaScript
- Graph Algorithms
- DFS/BFS
- Interview Preparation
- NodeJS
- MongoDB
- RESTful APIs
- MEAN Stack
- Algorithm Analysis
- Performance Optimization
- Interview Questions

## Data Structures & Algorithms Fundamentals

- [Data Structures in JavaScript: Arrays, HashMaps, and Lists](https://adrianmejia.com/Data-Structures-Time-Complexity-for-Beginners-Arrays-HashMaps-Linked-Lists-Stacks-Queues-tutorial): Beginner's guide to data structures: arrays, HashMaps, lists with complexity analysis
- [Priority Queue Data Structure and Heaps Implemented in JavaScript](https://adrianmejia.com/priority-queue-data-structure-and-heaps-time-complexity-javascript-implementation): Priority queues and heaps tutorial with JavaScript implementation and complexity analysis
- [How to find time complexity of an algorithm?](https://adrianmejia.com/how-to-find-time-complexity-of-an-algorithm-code-big-o-notation): Guide to analyzing algorithm time complexity using Big O notation
- [8 time complexities that every programmer should know](https://adrianmejia.com/most-popular-algorithms-time-complexity-every-programmer-should-know-free-online-tutorial-course): Essential algorithms and their time complexities for every programmer

## Graph Algorithms & Interview Problems

- [How to solve any graph/Maze interview questions in JavaScript? DFS vs. BFS](https://adrianmejia.com/how-to-solve-any-graph-2d-arrays-maze-interview-questions-in-javascript-dfs-vs-bfs): Graph algorithms tutorial: DFS vs BFS for maze and interview problems

## Full-Stack JavaScript Development

- [AngularJS tutorial for beginners with NodeJS ExpressJS and MongoDB (Part I)](https://adrianmejia.com/angularjs-tutorial-for-beginners-with-nodejs-expressjs-and-mongodb): MEAN stack tutorial: AngularJS, NodeJS, Express, and MongoDB for beginners
- [Creating RESTful APIs with NodeJS and MongoDB Tutorial (Part II)](https://adrianmejia.com/creating-a-restful-api-tutorial-with-nodejs-and-mongodb): RESTful API development with NodeJS, Express, and MongoDB tutorial
